states.empty: Explain both tracks, offer Load synthetic packet; disclosure synthetic, not validated against the real format remains visible at all times.
states.loading: While local service recognizes or IndexedDB commits, announce Processing or Saving, disable duplicate action only; keep sources and draft visible. No saved claim until transaction complete.
states.error: Field-specific errors preserve drafts. Uncertain raster region stays null. Unsupported image retains source for manual transcription. Missing ancestry requests history; quota/import errors produce zero partial writes. Explain blocked routing and next correction.
states.success: Show Saved locally separately from approved; queued, transferred, acknowledged, filed distinct. Review status and offsets visible; last acknowledgement and audit provide confirmation.

persistence: IndexedDB transactions atomically commit source/revision/review/queue/audit and acknowledged offsets. Preserve drafts per field and ordinary navigation/reload. Request persistent storage if available and explain eviction; export/reimport backup. This is not encrypted storage. Device-local Node service must remain available with external network disconnected; service unavailable yields explicit error and editable retained drafts, no invented result.
recovery: Show both conflicting quantities or edit versus deleted; allow choose/edit final value and confirm all heads. Save or discard unsaved changes before review or routing. Retry failed storage; import is validated before atomic commit and never grants approval. Pause/stop preserves queue. Destructive reset requires backup and deliberate confirmation. Escalate uncertain fields/categories to reviewer and deployment to owner.
keyboard: Native labeled buttons, inputs, selects, checkboxes and textarea; logical Tab order, visible focus, Enter only submits intended form, Escape closes confirmation with draft retained. Status changes use aria-live; errors link fields; text accompanies color. Desktop side-by-side source/review becomes single-column at narrow width with no hidden primary action; details expand inline.
